figma-desktop.description: Figma desktop app MCP server (local) - requires Figma desktop with Dev Mode enabled

playwright.description: Playwright browser automation - HEADED real Chrome with a persistent profile (~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/mcp-chrome-profile). Runs visibly so you can log in manually (e.g. LinkedIn, Chrome Web Store dev console); the session persists across restarts. Re-add --headless for silent/automated runs.
